observations: Front view of a white front-loading washing machine.
LG logo is visible on the top left of the control panel.
DirectDrive 7kg is printed on the left side of the panel.
Control panel features a central rotary dial and several push buttons.
A sticker on the right side of the panel indicates 'ON MOTOR 10 YEARS WARRANTY'.
The machine shows significant surface rust and wear on the lower front panel.
The door seal appears torn and dirty.
The interior drum is visible through the glass door but is dark and appears empty or heavily soiled.
The control screen is off in the photo.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year. No fault at all, the motor was never opened. Receipt and warranty card available.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The machine may not power on or the motor may be seized.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine powering on, the display lighting up, and the drum spinning.

risks.risk: The drum may be rusted through or have internal damage.
risks.proof: A photo of the drum interior with the door open.

risks.risk: The internal drum may be missing its protective liner or the door seal may be torn.
risks.proof: A photo of the drum with the door open.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the machine running through a full wash cycle.
Photo of the interior drum with the door open.
Photo of the manufacturer's label/plate usually found on the back or inside the door.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
